invitations_student_target_check.name: invitations_student_target_check
invitations_student_target_check.value: ("invitations"."environment" = 'student' and "invitations"."student_id" is not null and "invitations"."target_kind" is not null and (("invitations"."target_kind" = 'student' and "invitations"."guardian_id" is null) or ("invitations"."target_kind" = 'guardian' and "invitations"."guardian_id" is not null))) or ("invitations"."environment" <> 'student' and "invitations"."student_id" is null and "invitations"."guardian_id" is null and "invitations"."target_kind" is null)

routine_blocks_notes_length.name: routine_blocks_notes_length
routine_blocks_notes_length.value: "routine_blocks"."notes" is null or char_length("routine_blocks"."notes") between 1 and 500
